operator-pending state and counted operator-motion composition (2dw)
cursor movement (h, j, k, l, counts, 0, ^, $, g_, |, w, W, e, E, b, B, ge, gE, gg, G, gj, gk)
text entry and opening lines (i, I, a, A, o, O)
local character and replacement changes (x, X, r, R, s, S)
Visual Block replace (Ctrl-v, count, motion, r)
operator grammar (d, c, y with motions and counts; dd, cc, yy; D, C, Y)
hard reflow at an authored textwidth (gq, gw)
join lines with normalized or preserved whitespace (J, gJ)
